p='buggy.py'
s=open(p).read()

            pulse.set_frequency(freq*GHz, DriveChannel(qubit))
            pulse.play(spec_pulse, DriveChannel(qubit))''','''            # PulseSimulator does not support set_frequency. Modulate the pulse
            # envelope relative to the channel's nominal LO frequency instead.
            delta_freq = freq*GHz - center_frequency[qubit]
            sample_times = np.arange(drive_duration) * dt
            samples = spec_pulse.get_waveform().samples * np.exp(
                2j * np.pi * delta_freq * sample_times
            )
            shifted_pulse = Waveform(samples, name="frequency-shifted spec pulse")
            pulse.play(shifted_pulse, DriveChannel(qubit))''')
open(p,'w').write(s)
